entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A dangerous adventure world of ancient ruins and lethal risks, where the Roil still continues; the setting of Zendikar Rising.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who has returned to Zendikar and is willing to do anything to get rid of the Roil.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who has also returned home to Zendikar for reasons of her own.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A returning planeswalker of the Zendikar Rising set, featured on its Draft Booster artwork.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: The unpredictable ripples of change that wash through the land of Zendikar and still continue.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titanic beings absent from this storyline, though their ruin is seen.
